name: Genetic Congenital Malformation of the Eye with Glaucoma as a Major Feature
aliases: Congenital Eye Malformation with Secondary Glaucoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Congenital Ocular Dysgenesis with Glaucoma Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of congenital structural malformations of the anterior segment of the eye (e.g., anterior segment dysgenesis, corneal opacity, iris hypoplasia)
Clinical evidence of glaucoma including elevated intraocular pressure and optic nerve cupping
Identification of pathogenic variant in genes associated with ocular development and glaucoma (e.g., CYP1B1, FOXC1, PITX2)
Positive family history of congenital eye malformations or early-onset glaucoma

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital ocular malformation plus clinical evidence of glaucoma
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.

laboratory: Genetic testing identifying mutations in CYP1B1, FOXC1, PITX2, or other ocular development genes
imaging: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) showing optic nerve cupping
Ultrasound biomicroscopy revealing anterior segment malformations
genetic: Autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance patterns depending on gene involved
Pathogenic variants in CYP1B1, FOXC1, PITX2
other: Elevated intraocular pressure measurements via tonometry
Visual field testing showing glaucomatous defects

distinguishingFeatures: Typically isolated glaucoma without other ocular anomalies
Central corneal opacity with iridocorneal adhesions
More severe corneal defects and often cataracts
Systemic features including dental and facial anomalies
Characteristic iris strands and prominent Schwalbe's line

redFlags: Rapidly progressive visual loss in infancy
Severe corneal clouding obstructing visualization of anterior chamber
Markedly elevated intraocular pressure unresponsive to medical therapy
references: Orphanet: Genetic congenital malformation of the eye with glaucoma as a major feature, ORPHA:525677
Weisschuh N, et al. Genetic basis of congenital glaucoma and anterior segment dysgenesis. Prog Retin Eye Res. 2020.
Morrison JC, et al. The pathophysiology of glaucoma: a review. J Glaucoma. 2019.
